title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented places for solo work, research, tutoring, or group projects at Kettering College and across the surrounding Dayton library system.

cards.title: Build a research session around the main-floor collection
cards.subtitle: Main floor of the Kettering College Library
cards.notes: Start with the print collection, then borrow a laptop, calculator, charger, headphones, or portable whiteboard from the circulation desk.
cards.short_summary: A campus research base pairing physical resources with practical loaner equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: The library offers print books, journals, databases, a main-floor printer, and circulation-desk loans including laptops, calculators, headphones, chargers, and portable whiteboards.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Monday–Thursday 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m. and Friday 8:00 a.m.–noon; closed Saturday and Sunday. Check the page for changes.

cards.title: Reserve a room before the group chat becomes the workspace
cards.subtitle: Lower level of the Kettering College Learning Commons
cards.notes: Book through Smartway2 when a project needs a closed room, or check the panel outside each room before using an unreserved opening.
cards.short_summary: Reservable lower-level rooms designed for collaborative coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: Kettering College states that group study rooms are on the Learning Commons lower level and may be reserved through Smartway2 or the panel outside a room.
cards.access_notes: Students reserve with Kettering College portal credentials. Unreserved use is allowed, but confirmed reservations take priority.

cards.title: Turn a between-class gap into a short work block
cards.subtitle: Lower level of Boonshoft at Kettering College
cards.notes: Use the lounge for a brief review or document check, with the nearby campus printer/copier available when an assignment needs a hard copy.
cards.short_summary: A named student area suited to shorter campus work sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kettering College Library FAQ identifies a student lounge area on the lower level of Boonshoft and says a campus printer/copier is located there.
cards.access_notes: Campus access rules apply. Printing and copying incur per-page charges listed on the library page.

cards.title: Match the room size to the assignment
cards.subtitle: Dayton Metro Library on Far Hills Avenue in Kettering
cards.notes: Choose a four-person Quad for a small team or reserve the six-seat Group Study Room when everyone needs space for notes and devices.
cards.short_summary: The closest documented public-library option with several room configurations.
cards.evidence_claim: The branch provides free Wi-Fi, laptop and tablet lending, two four-person Quads, and one Group Study Room seating up to six people.
cards.access_notes: Located at 3496 Far Hills Ave. Review current branch hours and the library-space policy before reserving a room.

cards.title: Bring a four-person team to a Study Quad
cards.subtitle: Dayton Metro Library on Wilmington Pike in Kettering
cards.notes: Reserve one of the two Study Quads for a compact collaboration session, or use the six-seat Group Study Room for a larger team.
cards.short_summary: A Kettering branch with small-group rooms and device-friendly library services.
cards.evidence_claim: The branch offers free Wi-Fi, tablet and laptop lending, a six-person Group Study Room, and two four-person Study Quads.
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to posted branch hours and Dayton Metro Library's room policy; consult the direct page before reserving.

cards.title: Scale up for a presentation rehearsal
cards.subtitle: Dayton Metro Library on Watervliet Avenue
cards.notes: Use a two-person Tutor Room for focused review, a Quad for four, or a Group Study Room when six to eight collaborators need one table.
cards.short_summary: A flexible branch spanning tutoring, small teams, and larger project groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Southeast Branch lists two two-person Tutor Rooms, three four-person Quads, two Group Study Rooms for six to eight people, and free Wi-Fi.
cards.access_notes: Rooms are governed by Dayton Metro Library's space policy and branch schedule; verify availability through the reservation link.

cards.title: Separate group discussion from quiet reading
cards.subtitle: Dayton Metro Library beside the South RTA Transit Center
cards.notes: Reserve a Study Quad or six-person Group Study Room for discussion, then shift to the documented quiet reading room for individual review.
cards.short_summary: A transit-adjacent branch offering both collaborative and quieter settings.
cards.evidence_claim: The branch has three four-person Study Quads, a six-person Group Study Room, free Wi-Fi, device lending, and a documented quiet reading room.
cards.source_title: Miami Township Branch | Dayton Metro Library
cards.access_notes: The entrance is beside the fire station and South RTA Transit Center. Check current hours and reservation rules before traveling.

cards.title: Set up a focused off-campus work session
cards.subtitle: Dayton Metro Library in West Carrollton
cards.notes: Bring a laptop for Wi-Fi-based work or ask about the branch's group, tutor, and conference rooms before planning a shared study session.
cards.short_summary: A southwest Dayton-area branch with connected work and meeting facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: West Carrollton Branch lists free Wi-Fi, tablet and laptop lending, and group study, tutor, and conference rooms among its facilities.
cards.source_title: West Carrollton Branch | Dayton Metro Library
cards.access_notes: Room details and availability may require confirmation with library staff; visit only during the branch's currently posted hours.

cards.title: Use quiet hours for concentrated reading
cards.subtitle: Main Library on East Third Street in downtown Dayton
cards.notes: Plan reading or writing during the posted weekday Quiet Space period, or reserve a study room when the assignment requires conversation.
cards.short_summary: A downtown library with scheduled quiet periods and broad research facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Main Library publishes Quiet Space hours from 2:00–6:00 p.m. Monday through Friday and offers free Wi-Fi plus group study, tutor, and conference rooms.
cards.access_notes: Located at 215 E. Third St. Quiet Space hours are Monday–Friday, 2:00–6:00 p.m.; confirm current building hours on the page.

cards.title: Pick a room for tutoring or team review
cards.subtitle: Dayton Metro Library on Burkhardt Avenue
cards.notes: Pair up in a Tutor Room, gather four people in a Study Quad, or reserve the eight-seat Group Study Room for a broader exam review.
cards.short_summary: A room-rich branch accommodating pairs, quads, and larger study groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Burkhardt Branch provides two two-person Tutor Rooms, three four-person Study Quads, an eight-person Group Study Room, and free Wi-Fi.
cards.access_notes: Consult the branch schedule and Dayton Metro Library's meeting-room policy before reserving; RTA Route 2 serves the location.

warnings: The title is supplied editorial framing; no claim is made that these spaces are routinely occupied by 9:00 a.m.
Kettering College publishes only a limited number of individually named study environments, so the board includes documented public-library alternatives around Kettering and Dayton.
Coordinates and maps URLs are null because exact values were not independently verified from authoritative direct pages.
